title: 动态动作评估-过顶深蹲与单腿
requirements: Accepted sources have a real alpha channel and were visually checked after compositing on the shared light template.
Each scene uses one Bojji and one Despa, with no readable text, room, floor, cast shadow, duplicate pose or sequence framing.
Overview art is independently generated and compositionally distinct from its corresponding knowledge image.
Dynamic movement observation records visible movement and safety boundaries; it does not diagnose injury or prescribe treatment.

accepted.review: One controlled overhead squat with a calm observer establishes a non-diagnostic observation setting.
A shallow squat toward a low box supports observing a training task rather than labeling a defect.
A supported single-leg balance pose clearly conveys fixed task conditions and safe observation.
Shoes and the low box express recording context without diagnosis, symbols or extra evidence cards.
A simple open-hand cue and supported squat demonstrate one small low-risk change.
Separated stop gestures and the clear low box keep the safety stop non-diagnostic and respectful.
Independent compact squat-observer composition is distinct from the wide knowledge scene.
Independent rail-supported balance composition retains both full figures and the complete rail.
Independent shoes-and-low-box composition supports recording context without visual labels.
Independent cue-and-supported-squat composition shows a single low-risk change.
Independent stop composition preserves distance, a neutral low box and complete safe margins.

rejected.reason: Added unapproved picture cards and symbols instead of only shoes and a low box.
Despa's head was too close to the upper canvas edge.
Visible content was too close to the top and bottom canvas edges.
